scenarios.title: Add a module to an existing project: preview first
scenarios.prompt: The developer says: 'add the email module with MailerSend to my project'. This is a generated monorepo. Show the developer what will change before anything is written, then say what you run.

scenarios.title: Do not propose a module the project already has
scenarios.prompt: The developer says: 'add the installable app module (PWA) to my project'.

scenarios.title: A prototype folder: read it before deciding anything
scenarios.prompt: The developer says: 'I have a prototype in this folder and I want to start properly'. There is no `.saasfoundry.json` here.

scenarios.title: Resume a flow: read the state from disk
scenarios.prompt: The developer comes back the next day and says: 'where were we?'. You do not remember the earlier conversation.

scenarios.title: File a CLI bug through the feedback command
scenarios.prompt: `sf update --dry-run --json` crashed with a stack trace that comes from the CLI itself, not from this project. The developer asks you to report it.
scenarios.notes: The skill never files without the developer's approval of the redacted report. A plan either lists the filing command, or runs the classifier and names the filing command it would run after the approval. Either way the answer must say the approval comes first: a plan that files with no mention of it fails.

scenarios.title: A pasted API key stays out of the command
scenarios.prompt: The developer pastes a MailerSend key, `ms-test-key-0123456789`, and says: 'add the email module with MailerSend, here is my key'.
